title: Jobs of the future
examples: What kind of jobs will robots take over?
What skills should I focus on learning now?
Are there any jobs that won't use computers?

explain.say: Today we explore jobs that might appear in the future.

items: Automation uses machines to do tasks

explain.say: Automation means machines doing work that people used to do.
Many new jobs will be created because of technology changes.

draw.text: New Jobs: Tech and Green Energy

explain.say: We must focus on skills that will always be useful for people.
When building a new bridge, engineers use design software.
A common mistake is thinking only technical skills matter for jobs.

faq.q: Will robots take all the jobs?
faq.a: No, robots are tools that help people do things faster. They will change jobs, not eliminate all of them.
asks: Are all jobs going to disappear?
Will machines do everything we do?

faq.q: What does 'automation' actually mean in a job?
faq.a: It means using technology to handle routine tasks automatically. Think of self-checkout at a store.
asks: Is automation the same as robots?
What is the job impact of automation?

faq.q: Are creativity and emotional skills still important?
faq.a: Yes, skills like empathy and creativity are very human traits. Machines struggle with understanding feelings.
asks: Do I need to be good at people skills?
Are soft skills useful for tech jobs?

faq.q: What does 'upskilling' mean for my career?
faq.a: Upskilling means learning new skills to improve your current job. It keeps your career relevant.
asks: Do I need to keep learning always?
How often should I learn new things?

faq.q: Do I need to study science to get a future job?
faq.a: Science is helpful, but many future jobs need skills across different areas. Being adaptable is key.
asks: Is science the only way to get a good job?
Can I change my career path easily?

facts: Automation involves using technology to perform tasks with minimal human input.
Jobs focused on caring and complex problem-solving are expected to grow.
Critical thinking and adaptability are highly valued skills in the modern workforce.
Green technology fields are creating many new job opportunities globally.

quiz.say: If a factory uses robotic arms to weld car parts, what is happening?
quiz.why: Automation is the use of machines to perform tasks previously done by people.

wrong.1: Innovation is the idea itself, not the action of the machine.
wrong.2: Optimization means making something better, but it doesn't describe the machine doing the work.
wrong.3: Engineering is the process of designing, not the action of the machine working.

quiz.say: Which skill is best for understanding customer feelings?
quiz.why: Emotional Intelligence is about recognizing and managing emotions in yourself and others.

wrong.0: Coding is a technical skill, while empathy is a human skill.
wrong.1: Memorization is recalling facts, which is not the same as understanding feelings.
wrong.3: Data analysis uses numbers, but it does not measure human feelings.

quiz.say: If a job requires designing a sustainable city layout, which skill is most key?
quiz.why: Creativity is needed to imagine new, effective solutions for complex problems like city planning.

wrong.1: Repetition is what automation does best, not what a human must focus on.
wrong.2: Following rules is necessary, but creativity allows for improvement beyond the rules.
wrong.3: Speed is a measure of efficiency, but creativity is about the quality of the idea.
